verdict.rationale: Railway documents unlimited environments and per-pull-request preview environments, and its MCP server lets AI assistants manage environments, so agents can test somewhere other than production. The evidence never states that these environments use isolated data or databases separate from production. missing for 10: explicit documentation that non-production environments get their own isolated databases/data, guidance on agent-safe sandbox testing, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Unlimited environments mean everyone can ship simultaneously.
Every pull request gets its own preview. No surprises after merge.
It lets AI assistants create projects, deploy templates, manage environments, pull variables, and redeploy services.
